decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on maintained market data at low marginal cost, and after two years its value to utilities is still uncertain, so keeping the option open remains worthwhile.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core tariff databases, costs little to maintain, and has shown no signal that its value will fail to materialize.
With the broader regional energy calculator line withdrawn, the electricity tariff calculator remains the lean option in this space and is cheap to keep on the shared database.
The area definition tool underpins the remaining location-based products on the central platform, so it supports related options at little extra cost.
